# Hi, I'm Jacob! 

![](profile_picture.jpg){fig-align="left" width=250}

I'm a physicist and engineer who builds scientific software and hardware. Most recently, I was a Research Assistant at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, developing the data-processing pipeline for a space telescope. Before that, I spent two years in an optics lab at the University of Arizona, where I led the software and hardware upgrade of a robotic telescope.

I hold a BSc in Applied Physics from Columbia University. You can see more of my work on my [projects](projects.qmd) page, or take a look at [my CV](https://drive.google.com/file/d/13lBYExRXDENBM-nYClgpxorgocrQumGo/view?usp=sharing).
